subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

The actor was ridiculed for her __nonchalant__ attitude towards her work.
solution:
The correct answer is **'considerate'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nonchalant** means (of a person or manner) feeling or appearing casually calm and relaxed; not displaying anxiety, interest, or enthusiasm. (बेपरवाह)

 
 
• *Example - She gave a **nonchalant** shrug as if nothing happened.*
 
 
 
• **Considerate** means someone who is careful not to inconvenience or harm others. (विचारशील)
 
 
• *Example - She was extremely kind and **considerate**.*
 
 
 
• Clearly both words are **opposite in meaning**.
 
• Hence, '**considerate**' is the most appropriate** antonym **for the underlined word.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Boisterous** means noisy, energetic, and cheerful. (ऊर्जावान और हंसमुख)

 
 
• *Example - There was a group of **boisterous **lads.*
 
 
 
• **Unconcerned **means showing a lack of interest or worry. (उदासीन)
 
 
• *Example - Scott seemed **unconcerned** by his friend's problem.*
 
 
 
• **Retrospective** means looking back on or dealing with past events. (पूर्वप्रभावी)
 
 
• *Example - Our survey was **retrospective.***
